text: I yell out to my God, I yell with all my might, I yell at the top of my lungs. He listens.
my life was an open wound that wouldn't heal. When friends said, "Everything will turn out all right," I didn't believe a word they said.
I bow my head—then wring my hands.
I can't even say what's bothering me.
I ponder the years gone by.
wondering how to get my life together.

and give a long, loving look at your acts.
No god is great like God!
you showed everyone what you can do—
rescued the children of Jacob and Joseph.
saw you and trembled with fear; Deep Ocean was scared to death.
Sky exploded with thunder, your arrows flashing this way and that.
Lightning exposed the world, Earth reeled and rocked.
walked straight through roaring Ocean, but nobody saw you come or go.
You led your people like a flock of sheep.
